findings.detail: The site has 119 Maths Standard lessons: 56 in eight Year 11 folders and 63 in ten Year 12 folders that match the 2024 Standard 2 focus areas. Two Year 12 lessons are retired duplicates. There are no Standard 1 lessons; Standard 1 points are matched to the Standard 2 lesson for the same action.

The Year 11 site does not teach the BAC formulas, Time = BAC/0.015, BAC limitations or the Fried, Young and Clark medication formulas, although formulas-and-equations/lesson05 says these are examinable. No Year 11 lesson uses a spreadsheet in Earning money or Data analysis, and none teaches metric prefixes as powers of ten, interpolation and extrapolation, infographics, or why a shortest path may not be the best path.

Some live Year 11 pages teach content outside the 2024 Year 11 points: networks-paths-and-trees/lesson02 and lesson03 (degree sums, walks, trails, circuits, Eulerian ideas from the 2017 course), applications-of-measurement/lesson10 (scale drawings, a 2024 Year 12 Ratios and rates action), lesson11 (errors and limits of accuracy, not in the 2024 Year 11 points) and lesson12 (energy units, a 2024 Year 12 Standard 2 action). data-analysis/lesson08 reviews an older twelve-lesson statistics module including correlation and lines of best fit (Year 12).

lessonId values often name old module numbers or the wrong year (for example data-analysis/lesson09 to lesson13 are maths-std-y12-m8, networks lessons are maths-std-y12-m6, Year 12 trigonometry lessons 1 to 5 are maths-std-y11-m2). Data-analysis lessons are numbered 02 and 07 to 13 with no 01 or 03 to 06. curriculum-map.json drops the formula from one dotpoint (see site corrections).

limitations: No site file was changed. Page text was inspected; live interactive behaviour was not tested.

Coverage judgements were made from section text, term-overlap ranking and targeted keyword searches, not a full line-by-line read of all 119 lessons. A covered action can still contain a wording or worked-solution error.
Worked examples were not recalculated across the site; only the values quoted in the site corrections file were checked.
